C0.quote: Apportionment can be seen as a special case of the fair division
C0.note: The paper studies randomized apportionment of house seats to states from population counts. The input is a population profile, not submitted votes or ballots from agents. The results concern axioms (house/population monotonicity, quota, ex ante proportionality) and a dependent-rounding technique. The authors place the problem in fair division and allocation, so it is not a voting procedure aggregating agents' inputs. Coding stopped.
